# FabHotels

> > Budget hotel booking platform offering FabHotel Prime and FabExpress properties across major Indian cities with rooms starting from Rs.856

FabHotels provides couple-friendly, budget accommodation options across metro cities like Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Delhi, Chennai, and Kolkata, as well as tourist destinations. The platform features neighborhood-specific hotel listings with competitive pricing and up to 60% discounts.
